voice_language_desc: Language used for voice recognition, AI interpretation, and text-to-speech
tts_engine_desc: Piper runs fully on-device with a neural voice, but needs a voice model downloaded below for your language — falls back to the Android engine automatically if none is available.
overlay_text_preview: This is how the speaking overlay text will look.
app_alias_manager_desc: Define aliases so when you say a name (e.g. "youtube"), it routes to a specific installed app (e.g. LibreTube).
app_alias_empty: No app aliases defined yet. Tap "Add" to create one.
permission_query_packages_desc: Required to list installed apps for the Default Apps picker. Granted automatically at install.
cleanup_unused_msg: This will remove all downloaded models that are not currently selected as active or fallback. This action is final.
ww_aec_desc: Allows wake word during TTS/music playback
ww_music_duck_desc: Requires a clearer match while music is playing, to cut ghost triggers from echo residue
ww_sensitivity_desc: Adjust how easily the wake word triggers
ww_sensitivity_confirm_msg: Set wake word sensitivity to "%s"? The wake word engine will reload to apply it.
ww_api_key_required: This engine requires an API key. Enter it above to start.
stt_sensitivity_desc: Adjust how sensitive the microphone is when listening for commands
ww_calibrate_desc: Record your wake word 5 times to personalize detection sensitivity.
ww_delete_profile_msg: This will remove your voice calibration profile. Wake word detection will fall back to basic mode. Are you sure?
ww_calibrate_profile: Voice recognition active (language-agnostic, using your voice samples)
ww_calibrate_listening: Listening... say your wake word now
ww_calibrate_tap_ready: Tap 'Ready' when you're prepared to speak
profile_name_desc: Give your voice profile a name. It will appear in the notification instead of the wake word.
ww_engine_desc: Select the engine used for wake word detection.
ww_porcupine_accesskey_desc: Get your free AccessKey from console.picovoice.ai
ww_porcupine_keywords_hint: Built-in keywords: alexa, computer, hey google, hey siri, jarvis, porcupine, picovoice, terminator, etc. Or train a custom one at console.picovoice.ai and place the .ppn file in assets.
delete_model_message: Are you sure you want to delete %s?
clear_default_warning_message: It is recommended to have a default offline model selected for offline fallback. Are you sure you want to clear the default offline model?
debug_logging_desc: Write debug info to logcat — leave off unless you're troubleshooting an issue
cloud_intelligence_desc: Allow cloud engines (OpenAI) to interpret commands. Off keeps interpretation fully on-device — the local model is unaffected.
processor_info_vosk: • Vosk: Legacy, offline, supports multiple languages
processor_info_whisper_api: • Whisper API: Cloud-based, requires API key, high accuracy
delete_active_wakeword_warning: Warning: You are about to delete the active Wake Word model. The service will be stopped.
model_not_present: Selected Model not present on device
permission_mic_desc: Required to record and process your voice commands.
permission_notif_desc: Required to show the background service status.
permission_location_desc: Required for the weather search provider to get your local forecast.
battery_optimization_warning: Some phones kill background apps aggressively, which can silence wake-word detection until the OS reconnects it. Exempting this app from battery optimization keeps it running reliably in the background.
overlay_permission_desc: Display microphone overlay over other apps and menus.
benchmark_description: Synthetic speed test across cloud services and downloaded on-device models.
maintenance_warning: Maintenance actions are global and affect all AI engines.
integrations_description: Connect external services to enable voice-controlled playback and search.
spotify_integration_desc: Control Spotify playback via App Remote SDK
spotify_connect_failed: Connection failed. Make sure Spotify is installed and Client ID is correct.
spotify_error_auth_required: Spotify authorization required. Make sure your Spotify account is added as a test user in the Developer Dashboard (User Management).
spotify_error_redirect_uri: Redirect URI mismatch. Add 'voxcommander://spotify/callback' in your Spotify Dashboard > Settings > Redirect URIs.
spotify_error_network: Network error. Check your internet connection and try again.
spotify_error_timeout: Connection timed out. Spotify SDK did not respond. Try restarting the Spotify app.
spotify_client_id_required: Spotify Client ID is required. Set it in Advanced > Expert Settings first.
spotify_disconnect_message: You will need to reconnect to use Spotify voice controls.
spotify_oauth_message: Spotify requires OAuth login to enable voice-controlled playback. Connect now?
offline_banner: No internet connection. API calls (Spotify, YouTube, model downloads) are disabled. Local features still work.
spotify_client_id_desc: Required for Spotify integration. Get it from developer.spotify.com/dashboard

spotify_setup_step_user_mgmt: Step 6: In User Management, add your Spotify account email as a test user
spotify_setup_step_fingerprint: Step 7: In Settings > Android packages, add your package name and SHA-1 fingerprint (tap each to copy):
splash_no_network: No network available. Using cached assets.
lazy_processing_label: Lazy processing (use spoken words as query)
rule_mode_manual_hint: Pick the exact words to use as the search term below.
rule_mode_lazy_hint: Automatically uses whatever words are left after the trigger words as the search term.
rule_mode_any_order_hint: Trigger words can appear in any order (e.g. "turn on X" or "turn X on" both match).
default_apps_description: Select which apps VoxCommander can use for each category. Check the apps you want, then star one as default.
add_custom_category_desc: Enter a name for the new category (e.g. notes_apps, fitness)
media_session_permission_desc: Required to play music directly in Spotify and other media apps (like Google Assistant)
import_custom_model_desc: Select a model file from your device storage to use instead of downloading.
success_custom_vosk: Custom Vosk model folder set successfully
ww_openwakeword_custom_hint: Select a .onnx model file from your device. Trained models from openWakeWord can be imported here.
ww_engine_switch_warning_msg: The wake word service is currently running. Switching engines will stop the service. Continue?
metered_warning_msg: You are on a metered connection. You are about to download %s. Continue?
wifi_only_blocked_msg: Downloads are restricted to Wi-Fi only. Connect to Wi-Fi to download %s.
search_provider_uses_shared_key: Uses the API key from Settings → Models
tutorial_description: Restart the app and show the onboarding tutorial again. You can skip it at any time.
vox_apps_desc: Installed apps that implement the Vox contract
vox_apps_none: No Vox apps found. Install a satellite app (e.g. Vox Notes) to see it here.
onboarding_permissions_intro: Grant these so the voice assistant and its floating microphone work anywhere. You can change them later in Settings.
schema_updates_desc: Engines, search providers, media backends and integrations are declared in files served by the repository below. What shipped with the app is the fallback.
reset_schemas_button: Reset schemas to the shipped ones
reset_schemas_description: Deletes the copies downloaded from the repository. What shipped with this build applies again.
reset_schemas_confirm: Discard every schema downloaded from the repository and go back to the ones this build shipped with?
reset_settings_description: Puts every setting back to its default. API keys and downloaded models are kept.
reset_settings_confirm: Put every setting back to its default? API keys and downloaded models are kept. The app will restart.
schema_source_mixed: %1$d from the repository, %2$d shipped with the app
schema_use_remote_desc: Off runs exactly what this build shipped with, and deletes anything downloaded.
schema_using_bundled: Using the schemas shipped with the app
import_accepted_body: %1$s is now this engine’s model, and is selected.
import_rejected_wrong_kind: This engine loads %1$s. Nothing was copied.
import_rejected_empty: The folder you picked is empty. Nothing was copied.
import_rejected_unreadable: The file could not be read. Nothing was copied.
import_source_body: This engine can take the folder of an extracted model, or the archive it was published in.
import_source_delete_failed: The archive could not be deleted.
import_language_prompt: Which language is this model for?
schema_reason_rejected: refused: it did not parse, or arrived empty
schema_reason_unsigned: refused: no valid signature covers it
model_download_rejected: This download was refused: the file did not match the checksum the schema declares. It has been deleted — try again.
google_services_desc: Allow engines that use Google's on-device services (speech recognition). They run on the phone but are Google-operated.
gpu_toggle_desc: Run this engine on the GPU (OpenCL). Enabling runs a one-time compatibility test in a sandboxed process; if the device fails it, the switch turns itself off.
gpu_verdict_incompatible: This device failed the GPU test — running on the CPU.
gpu_verdict_probed: GPU test passed — awaiting first real use.
gpu_test_deferred_message: No model is loaded for this engine yet, so there is nothing to test against. The compatibility test will run automatically the next time a model is loaded, and this switch will turn itself off if the device fails it.
gpu_no_backend_message: This build has no GPU backend for this engine, or the device reports no usable GPU, so there is nothing to accelerate with. The engine keeps running on the CPU and the switch has been turned back off. No verdict was recorded against this device.
gpu_incompatible_msg: Your device's GPU driver could not run this engine. It stays on the CPU, which every device supports.
gpu_test_timeout: This can take up to 30 seconds
gpu_ready_message: Your GPU passed the inference test for this engine. GPU acceleration is active.
gpu_failed_message: Your GPU failed the test for this engine. It keeps running on the CPU.
backup_import_mode_desc: How restoring a file reconciles it against what's already here. Only applies when Data is on.
backup_import_mode_caveat_merge: Safest: restores the file and deletes only records that existed when it was exported — anything created here afterwards is kept.
backup_import_mode_caveat_full_override: DELETES everything — including records created AFTER the backup — then restores only what the file contains.
backup_import_mode_caveat_additive: Never deletes anything — restoring the same file again DUPLICATES its records.
